description: RFC 8785 3.2.3 key ordering (UTF-16 code units, not code points) and the IEEE-754 integer range. Both are invisible to the ASCII-only vectors in canonical.json.

tests.name: non_bmp_sorts_before_high_bmp
tests.why: U+1F600 encodes as the surrogate pair D83D DE00; D83D < FFFF in UTF-16, so it sorts FIRST. Code-point order gets this backwards.

tests.name: beyond_double_refused
tests.why: exact in Python, reads back as ...992 in any ECMAScript implementation — different hash, failed signature
